items.title: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say

extra.evidence: A Blog post by Dharma-AI on Hugging Face Predicting end-to-end fine-tuning time on shared GPU clusters, from 272 production runs. A preview of our upcoming paper, Predicting End-to-End Fine-Tuning Time for Generative Language Models . The full version will be on arXiv soon. GPUs are among the most expensive and scarcest resources in AI today. Anyone running a shared cluster has to decide, every day, which jobs go on which GPUs and in what order. That plan is only as good as the estimate of how long each job will take. When a job finishes hours early, GPUs sit idle until the next one is dispatched. When it runs hours late, everything queued behind it slips, experiments wait and delivery dates move. Better duration estimates turn this into planning instead of guesswork: what runs, when, and…

items.title: benjitaylor/skills
TeleChat to Xing4: Advancing Frontier Agentic Models on Domestic Chips and Frameworks
items.summary: We present Xing 4, a series of large language models that extends the TeleChat lineage through coordinated advances in model architecture and training infrastructure on Ascend. This report describes the design principles and systems engineering behind the series, spanning architecture selection, large-scale pretraining, and reasoning and agentic post-training. We study how sparse activation, attention design, model depth and width, and speculative decoding balance model capacity with computation, memory access, and execution overhead. Our pretraining infrastructure builds on MindSpore HyperParallel, combining topology-aware hybrid sharding, efficient distributed optimizer execution, and coordinated management of long-sequence workloads and activation memory. CPU affinity and core isolation further reduce host scheduling interference. Together, these mechanisms support the pretraining of a 285B-parameter model on 8,192 Ascend 910C cards, providing a concrete setting for the architectural and systems studies. For post-training, we introduce TeleGym, a unified agent execution platform that connects execution, evaluation, and trajectory construction to policy optimization. Disaggregated asynchronous execution, bounded oversampling, and partial rollout accommodate heterogeneous task durations while preserving trajectory continuity across policy updates. Together, these advances establish an Ascend-oriented training foundation for the continued development of Xing 4 across model s…

items.title: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers
items.summary: Standard neural architectures such as the Transformer were chosen because they train well with gradient descent and run fast on GPUs. In weight-space programming, a large language model (LLM) writes target weights by hand without gradient-based training, so those reasons no longer apply. Should we keep the Transformer? Given minimal guidance, ten labeled examples, and a sandbox, mainly on multiple-choice questions, we task three frontier LLMs with either generating the weights of a fixed architecture or designing the architecture themselves. When free to design, all three compile plain-text facts into a sparse table queried by a fixed procedure, reaching up to 54.4% test accuracy. An LLM-designed model achieves higher test accuracy than the most accurate released Transformer that the same LLM wrote while using about 1,800x fewer parameters. Without gradients, they choose a table, in which the LLM can state what each weight means and can find and rewrite a wrong one. Each wrong answer points to one row, and removing a row changes about one other answer. From this, we propose an associative-memory-based model up to 17x faster on GPUs than a same-sized Transformer. We also test pretrained weights, other benchmarks, and tasks where models generate answers. Pretrained LLMs remain more accurate; the claim concerns which structure to build when writing weights.

items.title: AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs
items.summary: Kernel optimization is essential for efficient large language model (LLM) training and inference on Ascend NPUs. Existing Ascend kernel benchmarks primarily focus on kernel generation, with less emphasis on the ability of agents to optimize existing implementations under input configurations drawn from real workloads. To address this requirement, we introduce AscendGYM, a benchmark whose initial suite comprises 48 kernels across three difficulty levels. Each kernel is paired with test cases whose data types and tensor shapes are collected from real-world training and inference tasks. Consequently, performance improvements on AscendGYM map directly to the corresponding workloads. In terms of usability, two evaluation modes are supported in AscendGYM: model evaluation and model-harness evaluation. The kernel optimization capabilities of both trained models and custom agents are allowed to be measured. It provides a complete execution environment that closely reproduces how Ascend kernels are invoked in practical pipelines. For model evaluation, it additionally includes a built-in harness equipped with search orchestration and experience accumulation. Finally, we propose a new metric, the Speedup-Token Score (STS), which quantifies performance gains relative to token cost. By jointly considering speedup and cost, STS enables the assessment of practical kernel optimization capability of a model or harness under an acceptable budget. AscendGYM is available at https://github.com/S…

items.title: VoxMel TTS Technical Report
items.summary: Continuous autoregressive TTS relies on an acoustic target that enables stable next-latent modeling while preserving fine-grained acoustic details. While existing approaches employ learned compressed representations (e.g., continuous VAE latents) to render prediction tractable, they rely on complex neural encoders that often cap generation fidelity. Conversely, training-free targets like mel-spectrograms eliminate encoder overhead, yet their potential for autoregressive generation remains largely underexplored. In this work, we propose VoxMel, a tokenizer-free framework for autoregressive TTS that makes stable mel modeling tractable through a fixed, exactly invertible two-axis Haar transform. The transform first decomposes each mel spectrogram along frequency into local averages and a frequency residual, then splits the averaged component along time into Coarse-Mel and a temporal residual. A language-model backbone with a flow-matching head autoregressively generates Coarse-Mel. Non-autoregressive residual tiers then predict the temporal residual from Coarse-Mel, followed by the frequency residual conditioned on the reconstructed Frequency-Averaged Mel. Neither residual is fed back into the autoregressive history. Trained on 100K hours of Emilia, the supervised 0.6B model obtains 1.51\% WER and 0.738 speaker similarity (SIM) on test-en, and 1.29\% CER and 0.755 SIM on test-zh. GRPO improves these results to 1.15\% WER / 0.753 SIM and 1.17\% CER / 0.776 SIM, respectively. We…

items.title: G-CAST: Governed Continual Self-Training for E-Commerce Agents under Evolving Demands
items.summary: With the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), an increasing number of users are turning to LLM-powered agents for conversational shopping in e-commerce. However, the user needs continue to change as new product categories, procurement scenarios, and feature requests emerge. At the same time, the product's execution harness-including its tools, skills, and operating procedures-continues to evolve to support increasingly sophisticated interactions. These changes create two practical challenges: 1) Demand drift alters the distribution, intent, and complexity of user requests, causing a model trained once to fall behind; 2) Harness evolution requires the model to use newly introduced capabilities correctly without losing behavior that users already rely on. Periodic manual retraining is too delayed and labor-intensive for this setting. To address these challenges, we present G-CAST, a governed continual self-training system that converts daily production evidence under evolving demand and capability contracts into reward-routed, entropy-prioritized training data and governed reward evolution. Governed checkpoint transition under cumulative evaluation controls each model update, enabling the agent to learn newly introduced behaviors without sacrificing previously accepted capabilities. Experiments on a real production e-commerce agent show that G-CAST achieves stronger adaptation to newly introduced demand while better preserving previously accepted behavior compare…

e13a5a4dae3c.body: Gemini 4 Carbon 在某些任务上耗时接近一小时，而 Opus 和 Astra 仅需几分钟，实际使用中速度不可接受。

04b0992aad3c.headline: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Neon 模型
04b0992aad3c.body: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Neon 模型，支持文本、图像、视频、音频和 PDF，上下文窗口为一百万个 token。

8a6b5c2794b6.headline: RadixArk 发布 DaisyRose-27B 模型
8a6b5c2794b6.body: RadixArk 发布 DaisyRose-27B 模型，在 Terminal-Bench 4.1 上 pass@1 提升至 12.0%。

974cfba453ba.headline: Dharma-AI 分析微调耗时预测
974cfba453ba.body: Dharma-AI 分析了 272 个生产环境微调案例，预测端到端微调时间，解决共享 GPU 集群调度难题。

420d14f9c6e8.headline: InclusionMed 平台上线
420d14f9c6e8.body: 全球首个医疗健康 AI 独立评测与分析平台 InclusionMed 正式上线，提供评测图谱和指数。

977c9bf880de.headline: vLLM 使用 FlyDSL MonoKernels
977c9bf880de.body: vLLM 使用 FlyDSL MonoKernels 在 AMD Instinct GPU 上实现高交互性解码，提升智能体响应速度。

7b692ce84d0e.headline: LocalAI 发布 5.0.0 版本
7b692ce84d0e.body: LocalAI 发布 5.0.0 版本，新增桌面应用、项目管理和 Python 沙箱，支持 Office 文档和团队共享。

f32a2b193e81.headline: openai/whisper：鲁棒语音识别
f32a2b193e81.body: whisper 项目通过大规模弱监督实现鲁棒语音识别，支持多种语言和任务。

4f44f430a76e.headline: bojieli/ai-agent-book：AI Agent 开源书籍
4f44f430a76e.body: 《深入理解 AI Agent：设计原理与工程实践》开源主仓库，包含正文、PDF 与配套代码。

4012fee7db34.headline: colbymchenry/codegraph：代码知识图谱
4012fee7db34.body: codegraph 提供预索引代码知识图谱，自动同步代码变更，支持多个智能体，减少 Token 消耗。

83d079a8ca05.headline: p-e-w/heretic：无需训练的语言模型修改工具
83d079a8ca05.body: heretic 是一个无需训练的语言模型修改工具，可移除审查、抑制废话、减少谄媚行为。

29baccefa316.headline: LangSmith 新增编码智能体报告
29baccefa316.body: LangSmith 新增编码智能体报告功能，将支出与生成的拉取请求关联，便于追踪成本。

05b0a9b7c101.headline: benjitaylor/skills：AI 编码代理技能
05b0a9b7c101.body: skills 项目为 AI 编码代理提供技能支持，帮助代理完成更复杂的编程任务。

42b8e181477f.headline: Xing4：基于国产芯片与框架的前沿智能体模型
42b8e181477f.body: Xing4 系列大语言模型通过在昇腾芯片上的架构和训练基础设施改进，扩展了 TeleChat 谱系。

d9ad411eca75.headline: 权重空间编程无需 Transformer
d9ad411eca75.body: 研究探讨了在无需梯度训练的情况下，大语言模型如何通过手动编写目标权重来设计模型结构。

ac082902b21c.headline: AscendGYM：Ascend NPU 上成本感知的内核优化基准
ac082902b21c.body: AscendGYM 是针对 Ascend NPU 上真实工作负载的内核优化基准，包含 48 个内核和三个难度级别。

cd91450b6c4a.headline: VoxMel 提出无分词器自回归语音合成框架
cd91450b6c4a.body: VoxMel 提出一种无分词器的自回归语音合成框架，旨在解决现有方法依赖复杂编码器的问题，以提升生成保真度。

099d3df2149b.headline: G-CAST 实现电商智能体受控持续自训练
099d3df2149b.body: G-CAST 系统通过受控检查点转换和奖励路由，使电商智能体在引入新行为的同时保留已接受的能力。
